freeze_rule: This protocol is frozen only when committed and hash-registered BEFORE any outcome access. Editing any field below after outcome access voids the study and must be recorded as a post-outcome tolerance change.

risk_functional.name: finite_sample_calibrated_selective_risk
why_not_raw_maximum: tau ceiling: every R24 pool branch admits on excess <= tau + TOL, so bound <= tau identically; verified 0/1633 non-null bounds exceed tau=0.02, max 0.019561442517
exchangeability floor: P(L_new > max of K exchangeable losses) = 1/(K+1); POOL_K=2 gives 1/3 > 0.10
risk_functional.estimator: r_hat = L_(ceil((n+1)*(1-alpha))) over CALIBRATION-selected losses, ascending order statistics
risk_functional.n_definition: count of CALIBRATION rows with s(x)=select
risk_functional.test_reporting: violation rate with one-sided Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound
risk_functional.escape_argument: r_hat is an order statistic of the realised CALIBRATION loss distribution; no admission predicate caps it, so its range matches the target's range. The ceil((n+1)(1-alpha)) rank replaces the K=2 maximum, giving finite-sample validity at the declared alpha under exchangeability.
risk_functional.assumption_not_result: Exchangeability between CALIBRATION and TEST is assumed, not proved. Validity is assessed WITHIN each domain and never pooled across domains.

custody.invariant: r_hat derived from CALIBRATION only; TEST never used for metric learning, arm selection, or threshold choice

verifiable_check.manifest: each split emits a sorted SHA-256 manifest of instance identifiers
verifiable_check.assertion_1: pairwise intersection of TRAIN/CALIBRATION/TEST manifests is empty
verifiable_check.assertion_2: recorded r_hat is bit-identical to the value recomputable from the CALIBRATION manifest alone
verifiable_check.assertion_3: no TEST identifier appears in any fitting or thresholding trace
verifiable_check.on_failure: hard executor failure, not a warning

custody.split_assignment: by SHA-256 of immutable instance identifier, fixed before outcome access, following extensions/r15 precedent
custody.independent_verify: two byte-identical process runs (run_a/run_b), matching the R24 custody standard where run_a.result.json and run_b.result.json resolved to one blob

arms.description: exact representation fibre; equality of phi
R24 arm-conditional boundary geometry, recalibrated under the new functional
no-geometry lexical rule, information- and budget-matched; the R24 control that already matched geometry at 44/44 with fewer violations (14 vs 20)
kNN / random-forest selector; neighbour count is an acquisition parameter and never enters bound construction
random metric at matched budget; isolates whether structure or budget drives any effect
abstain-always floor; establishes the trivial-validity baseline that coverage must beat
A_t/B_t fibre with D(z) >= 2t-1; must NOT be certifiable at radius < D(z)/2. Certifying it indicates an executor defect.

abstention.rule: abstain when the calibrated selective bound cannot be issued at alpha for the instance's fibre
abstention.reported: abstention rate is reported per domain per arm, never suppressed

coverage.rationale: R24 reached 44/44 coverage and still failed validity at 20/44 violations; coverage alone is not evidence of a working certificate

domains.disjointness: domain-level; replaces R24 fold-role reuse of one 44-dataset corpus
domains.availability_rule: availability is a PREREQUISITE verified before freeze, not an assumption. A domain that cannot supply the pool floor is dropped before outcome access and recorded as a prerequisite failure; never back-filled after seeing results.
domains.no_pooling: metrics are compared within domain; values are not pooled across domains (extensions/r15 precedent)

sample_size.interpretation: post-selection AND post-abstention floor on TEST

gates.statement: one-sided Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound on TEST violation rate <= 0.10 in EVERY domain
R24_GEOMETRY improves coverage by >= 10 points over LEXICAL_CONTROL at the same certified risk
realised decision value noninferior to the strongest learned comparator
IMPOSSIBILITY_WITNESS is NOT certified at radius < D(z)/2

gate_execution: hard gates are EXECUTED, not logged. A failed hard gate stops terminal precedence at the corresponding adverse terminal.

stop_rule.statement: If the lexical or learned control matches geometry after valid calibration, STOP rehabilitating geometric transfer and publish the boundary result.
stop_rule.note: This is a legitimate publishable terminal, not a failure to be revived.

pre_freeze_outcome_exposure.text: The complete R24 result was inspected before this design. This protocol is prospective only with respect to NEW policy output. Known-outcome exposure is declared following the R23/R24 PRE_FREEZE_OUTCOME_EXPOSURE precedent.

forbidden_actions: increasing compute or budget in place of resolving the scientific claim
retuning any threshold after outcome access
selecting an arm after seeing TEST outcomes
changing the fallback after seeing TEST outcomes
substituting a domain after a prerequisite failure
asserting unconditional impossibility for any pool size, radius or metric
claiming the risk functional is novel
